standard_prerequisites.name: Mayer-Vietoris for Hom
standard_prerequisites.use: Long exact sequence for Hom on a two-open covering.

core_obligations: Define F through the distinguished triangle F -> Rj_{U,*}A  oplus  Rj_{V,*}B -> Rj_{U cap V,*}(B|_{U cap V}) -> F[1], where the second map is the obvious one and the first is the composition of the restriction counit with Rj_{U cap V,*}c (proof lines 11097-11110).

Restrict to U: both (Rj_{V,*}B)|_U and (Rj_{U cap V,*}(B|_{U cap V}))|_U are canonically isomorphic to Rj_*(B|_{U cap V}) with j : U  cap  V -> U, so the second arrow has a section and F|_U -> A is an isomorphism; similarly F|_V -> B (proof lines 11111-11119).

Given E, a : A -> E|_U, b : B -> E|_V agreeing on the overlap, the existence of the morphism F -> E follows from the Mayer-Vietoris sequence for Hom (Lemma mayer-vietoris-hom) (proof lines 11120-11124).
proof_roadmap: Define F by the pushforward triangle.
Split the second arrow after restriction to U and to V.
Obtain the morphism to E from the Mayer-Vietoris sequence for Hom.
difficulty_reason: The object F is defined by a distinguished triangle built from the two pushforwards; restricting to U makes the second arrow split, giving the isomorphism F|_U =~ A (and similarly V); the morphism to E comes from the Mayer-Vietoris sequence for Hom.
